identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime] Compose the production birthday and witness activation path

values.goal: Compose all verified resident authorities into one exactly-once production birthday/witness transaction and repeat the Runtime feature-wiring audit against the merged production tree.
values.required_outcome: A real long-lived Runtime resident is denied before readiness, receives exactly one durable validated birthday and witness receipt after all governed prerequisites pass, restores without replay, continues useful work, and has source-grounded proof that every required feature is live-wired.
declared_scope: Runtime-kernel production birthday aggregate, validation, durability, and recovery
Canonical v0.92 feature and quality-gate truth
authority_boundary: Existing identity, continuity, Memory Palace, capability, cognitive-profile, Adaptive Learning, ACC, and birth-witness modules remain their domain authorities
Issue 451 owns only serial composition, exactly-once activation state, recovery, and complete production-path proof
No input digest, readiness status, witness, or prior receipt is self-certifying
A feature that is only a library, fixture, metadata row, document, or unreachable code remains unimplemented for this issue
No birthday receipt implies personhood, consciousness, emotion, citizenship, or public launch authority
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle and an issue-bound FastWork worktree
Consume #446 and #448-#450 only at their merged ancestral revisions
Preserve unrelated worktrees and primary main
Use focused local proof; no AWS or paid runner
Do not restore retired #5347 demo binaries
